title: Record design decisions for jmap-cid spec
description: Document the two resolved design decisions for draft-atwood-jmap-cid: (1) SHA-256 only (no multihash/IPFS CID), aligned with existing jmap-chat sha256 field and complementary to JMAP-BLOBEXT digest:sha-256; (2) standalone capability urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid, structured modularly for potential upstream patches to RFC 8620 and JMAP-FILENODE.
notes: Decision 1: SHA-256 only. No multihash/IPFS CID. Lowercase hex encoding. Field named sha256 (complements JMAP-BLOBEXT digest:sha-256 which is base64 on Blob/get). Decision 2: Standalone capability urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid. Modular sections structured to double as upstream patches to RFC 8620 and JMAP-FILENODE.
close_reason: Draft written: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00.md. Design decisions recorded in beads memory. SHA-256 only, standalone capability urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid.
